title: Feed Override Active — Non-Standard Cutting Condition
description: Feed override P083 set to {val}% (nominal 100%) during production program. Spindle speed P001 = {val2} RPM. Non-standard override active for >10 parts.
probable_cause: Operator compensation for tool wear, material hardness variation, or unresolved vibration issue.
diagnostic_steps: Interview operator for reason override was applied
Check if override masks a recurring alarm
Verify correct tool is loaded in spindle
Review last SPC data for dimension drift
remedy: Restore nominal feed rate. If override required for quality, initiate cutting parameter review with process engineer.
required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.
escalation_path: If SPN-MD-002 is not addressed (log fault. schedule maintenance within 24 hours. reduce feed rate by 20%.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-SR-001, then SPN-MJ-003. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
